settings.question: What Is Your Return and Exchange Policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns and size exchanges within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed and undamaged, with all original Vivnook tags attached.Once your request is approved, we'll provide a prepaid return label at no cost.Please note that custom-hemmed pants and items with personalized name, title or motif embroidery are final sale.To get started, email us at support@vivnook.com or submit the Return Request Form.

settings.question: What Are Your Shipping Rates & Delivery Times?
settings.answer:
Orders of US$100+ qualify for free standard shipping. For orders below US$100, shipping rates are shown at checkout.Most standard orders are processed within 1–3 business days, followed by estimated transit times of:

  • United States: 7–12 business days
  • Australia: 8–12 business days
  • Europe: 6–10 business days (Italy: 8–12)
  • Asia: 3–5 business days

Custom and embroidered orders require an additional 5–10 business days for processing.

settings.question: How Does Complimentary Hemming Work?
settings.answer: We offer complimentary hemming for our EverTrue™ Scrub Pants.After you place your order, our team will contact you to confirm whether you'd like an adjustment and your preferred finished length before we proceed.Please note that custom-hemmed pants are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.

settings.question: How Do I Find My Best Fit?
settings.answer: Check the size guide on each product page and compare the listed measurements before ordering.For THE LOOK, you can choose your EverTrue™ Scrub Top and EverTrue™ Scrub Pants sizes separately for a more personalized fit.Still unsure? Reach out to us at support@vivnook.com. We're happy to help you find your fit.
